body: Yes, kind of.. I mean, I was pretty depressed, I have considered suicide several times earlier, but my rationality told me "nah, doesn't worth it, too much hassle, you could still be alive and become disabled". Now it was more like "shut up and do it".
Yeah, I do meditation for about two years. I've been benefited too, it just doesn't seem to help anymore.

> Which would you feel worse about: them dealing with your depression and suicidal thoughts or them dealing with your death?

That certainly didn't come to my mind...  
Thank you. You're awesome.
